Care that matters

Packing and protection
for your belongings.

Boxes and protection suited to dishes, books, clothes, artwork, valuable objects and furniture. Packing, unpacking and protection for mattresses and bed bases are arranged according to your chosen service.

Dismantling, handling, placement and reassembly are specified in the agreed package.

  • Packing fragile items and hanging clothes
  • Protecting televisions, hi-fi equipment, mirrors and artwork
  • Supplying packing materials and placing furniture
